name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for trip hazard removal?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for hiring City Dweller, LLC for trip hazard removal?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our process begins with a free initial consultation where we discuss your concerns and schedule an on-site assessment. During the assessment, our team will thoroughly inspect your property to identify all existing and potential trip hazards. We then provide a detailed proposal outlining the recommended solutions, materials, timeline, and a transparent cost estimate. Upon your approval, we schedule the work at your convenience and execute the repairs efficiently, ensuring minimal disruption to your daily routine, and conduct a final walkthrough upon completion.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes a consultation, on-site assessment, detailed proposal, scheduling, execution of repairs, and a final walkthrough.
